JetBlue flight reports drone strike approaching New York's JFK airport

A JetBlue Airbus A321 flight reported a drone strike at approximately 3,000 feet altitude while on final approach to New York's JFK Airport. The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has initiated an investigation into the incident. The flight landed safely, and no damage was found.
